rationale: The claim involves a rear-end motor vehicle collision resulting in a totaled vehicle and injuries to the policyholder, which falls squarely under auto coverage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM by an at-fault driver traveling ~35 mph who did not brake. The vehicle is totaled (trunk fully crushed into the back seat), and Pat sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. The at-fault driver's insurance information is documented on the police report. Claim is classified HIGH severity due to total vehicle loss and multi-symptom injuries with escalation potential.

case_facts.description: Policyholder was rear-ended at a red light by another driver traveling approximately 35 mph who did not brake. Entire trunk crushed into the back seat; vehicle is totaled.
case_facts.injuries: Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist
case_facts.vehicle_status: Totaled - trunk fully crushed into back seat
case_facts.other_party: At-fault driver; insurance info available on police report
